description: Cartographie des inondations du printemps is a series of datasets listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. Données liées au suivi des inondations 2019 au Québec Attention: les données d'étendue d'eau sont une interprétation en temps quasi réel de données satellites; elles ont été produites en mode opérationnel et sont fournies telles quelles sans validation exhaustive. Le produit peut contenir des erreurs, en particulier dans les zones urbaines. Coverage: Québec. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère de la Sécurité intérieure. Its tags are Carte, Catastrophe, Crue, Inondation. It offers 11 resource(s) in GEOTIFF, HTML, JPEG, SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2025-10-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
